title: The Authentic Creator - Creative Truth
author: Unknown
description: The Authentic Creator: A Philosophical Exploration into Your Creative Truth, published under the name Creative Truth, a short workbook-style guide for 'multipotentialites', people with many interests and creative directions. It opens by acknowledging that multipotentiality is confusing and sets out the five most common paradoxes: generating many ideas but being paralysed by them, loving learning but bored easily, purpose-led rebels wanting to save the world, and similar tensions. It then leads the reader through reflections and exercises on identity, values, purpose, creative process and how to build a life and work around varied passions rather than a single specialism. It is a contemporary creativity and self-discovery resource, not an esoteric text.
